meta.name: pptx
meta.description: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email or summary); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user mentions "deck," "slides," "presentation," or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. If a .pptx or .potx file needs to be opened, created, or touched, use this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建、编辑和提取演示文稿内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要处理 .pptx 或 .potx 格式的演示文稿文件
copy.tagline_en: Create, edit, and extract content from presentations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work with .pptx or .potx presentation files

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以创建、编辑和读取 .pptx 和 .potx 文件。它能生成新演示文稿、从模板构建、提取文本、修改幻灯片、合并或拆分文件，并处理备注和评论。
howto.when: 当你提到“幻灯片”、“演示文稿”、“deck”或任何 .pptx/.potx 文件名时触发。也适用于需要打开、创建或处理这些文件的任何场景。

say.text: 帮我创建一个关于市场分析的演示文稿。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个 .pptx 文件。

say.text: 从这份 .pptx 中提取所有文本。
say.note: Claude 会读取并返回幻灯片内容。

say.text: 把这个模板 .potx 应用到我的幻灯片上。
say.note: Claude 会基于模板编辑现有文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create, edit, and read .pptx and .potx files. It can generate new presentations, build from templates, extract text, modify slides, merge or split files, and handle speaker notes and comments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "slides," "presentation," "deck," or any .pptx/.potx filename. Also applies whenever these files need to be opened, created, or processed.

say_en.text: Create a presentation about market analysis.

say_en.note: Claude will read and return slide content.

say_en.text: Apply this .potx template to my slides.
say_en.note: Claude will edit the existing file based on the template.
